name: TOUQI
source: As a new member of the Xifeng Magazine, your task is to investigate the connections between posts on Xifeng's forum as assigned by the editor-in-chief. When necessary, you will need to conduct on-site explorations to uncover the secrets hidden behind the posts.
translation: 作为西风杂志的新会员，你的任务是按照主编的指派，调查西风论坛上帖子之间的联系。必要时，你需要进行现场探索，揭开帖子背后隐藏的秘密。
